title: Full Agreement Across Multiple LLMs
body: ChatGPT/Gemini/Claude all had to agree before a screening call stood - cutting manual screening 70%.

title: How Well Do LLMs Screen Abstracts?
body: GPT-4 matched human include/exclude calls 84-95% of the time and cleared 200 abstracts in 20 minutes.

title: Human-Comparable Screening Sensitivity
body: Splitting eligibility into three questions - design, population, controls - brought GPT to human sensitivity.
credit: Annabel V. Dang and Lyra G. Toohey
